app.title: Fiskal
import.no_new: This file added no new movement.
import.no_accounts: Create an account above before importing a statement.
transactions.title: Transactions
account.name: Account name
validate.page_limit: Showing the first {shown} of {total} pending movements. Validate them to see the next ones.
transactions.limit_reached: Showing only the {limit} most recent matching movements. Narrow the filters to see older ones.
home.pending_help: Movements waiting in the Validate queue.
transactions.send_back_help: Moves a movement a rule validated back to the Validate queue, keeping its classification as the proposal. No rule validates it again; your next decision is final.
transactions.sent_back: Movement sent back to the Validate queue.
validate.submit_help: Marks this movement as validated with the type, category, cost center and holder shown above. Change them first if the proposal is wrong.
validate.create_rule_help: Also creates a rule from the pattern below. The rule validates every other pending movement it matches, now and in future imports.
validate.rule_pattern_help: Text a movement's description or counterparty must contain, ignoring upper and lower case.
validate.rule_created: Rule created. It classified and validated {count} other pending movements.
language.label: Language
validate.no_cost_center: You have not created any cost center yet. Create one in Settings (for example one per property or per activity) to classify your movements.
settings.cost_centers_intro: A cost center answers "who or what does this belong to?". Create one for each person, property or activity you want to track separately. Deactivated items are kept on existing movements.
settings.categories_intro: A category answers "what is this?". Deactivated categories stay visible on existing movements but cannot be chosen for new ones.
settings.rules_intro: Rules classify new movements automatically. Saving a change reclassifies only pending movements; validated movements never change.
settings.name: Name
settings.proration_months_help: Leave empty for no proration. Otherwise the number of months a cost is spread over.
settings.rule_seed_note: This is a default rule shipped with the application. Editing it keeps your version.
settings.rule_priority_help: Lower numbers win. Your rules always come before default rules.
settings.rule_saved: Rule saved. Pending movements were reclassified.
settings.error.name_empty: The name must not be empty.
settings.error.name_too_long: The name must have at most {max} characters.
settings.error.name_in_use: The name "{name}" is already in use.
settings.error.cost_center_missing: The cost center does not exist.
settings.error.cost_center_in_rules: {count} active rule(s) still assign this cost center; change or deactivate them first.
settings.error.cost_center_in_accounts: {count} account(s) still use this cost center by default.
settings.error.invalid_choice: The selected option is not valid.
settings.error.income_source_required: An income category needs an income source.
settings.error.proration_months_positive: The proration months must be a positive number.
settings.error.kind_in_use: The kind of a category in use cannot change.
settings.error.category_in_rules: {count} active rule(s) still assign this category; change or deactivate them first.
category.income.work.help: Salary and other earnings from employment or self-employment.
category.income.benefit.help: Public benefits and allowances, such as unemployment or family support.
category.income.rental.help: Rent received from properties you let.
category.income.other.help: Gifts and one-off inflows that are not earnings.
category.housing.help: Rent or mortgage payments and community fees for your home.
category.utilities.help: Electricity, water, gas, internet and phone.
category.transport.help: Public transport, fuel, tolls and parking.
category.healthcare.help: Doctors, medicines, insurance and dental care.
category.education.help: Tuition, courses, books and school supplies.
category.shopping.help: Clothing, household goods and other purchases.
category.savings.help: Money set aside for savings or investments.
category.taxes.help: Income tax, property tax and other public charges.
category.rental_expenses.help: Costs of a property you let: taxes, repairs, insurance and community fees.
category.misc.help: Anything that fits no other category.
costcenter.personal.help: Spending that belongs to one person.
costcenter.household.help: Spending shared by the whole household.
costcenter.work.help: Spending related to your work or business.
guided.intro: Movements with the same description are grouped, so one decision classifies all of them. The largest groups come first.
guided.empty: No description repeats among the pending movements. Use the queue for the rest.
guided.spread_warning: The amounts in this group differ widely ({low} to {high}). A rule on this description is risky: validate only these movements without a rule, or review them one by one in the queue.
guided.affected_with_rule: This will classify {count} pending movements: {group} of this group and {others} more that the rule also validates.
guided.create_rule: Also create a rule for this description
guided.create_rule_help: Creates a rule from the pattern below. It validates the movements of this group and the other pending movements it matches, and classifies future imports. Leave it unchecked to validate only these movements, by hand.
guided.submit_help: Validates every pending movement of this group with the type, category, cost center and holder shown above.
guided.rule_created: Rule created. It also validated {count} other pending movements.
guided.undo_help: A mistake in a group is not final: return its movements to pending and classify them again.
guided.undo_limit: Showing the {shown} most recent of {total} validated groups.
guided.undo_group_help: Returns every movement of this group to pending and deactivates the rule the group created, if any.
guided.undo_rows_limit: Showing the {shown} most recent movements of this group.
guided.undone_rule: The rule created with the group was deactivated.
guided.undone_skipped: {count} movements were changed after the group was validated and were left as they are.
